    # We know that h(s1, s2) + h(s1, s3) + h(s1, s4) = h(s2, s3) + h(s2, s4) + h(s3, s4)
    # This is because each pair is counted twice in the sum of all pairwise Hamming distances
    total_sum = (h12 + h13 + h14 + h23 + h24 + h34) // 2

    # Check if the calculated distances are valid
    if h12_new < 0 or h13_new < 0 or h14_new < 0 or h23_new < 0 or h24_new < 0 or h34_new < 0:
        return -1
